source: Dark Ages: Werewolf, Pack Totems, pp. 227-231 (pdf 228-232), and Bear's refusal, p. 193 (pdf 194). Rules in our own words with page refs. Used in the Dark Ages and the Long Night (B7860). The Given traits hold for every packmate while the totem favours the pack; a Pack trait is used by one packmate a turn; the Story pool of Willpower is shared and comes back each story (p. 228). A totem the Dark Ages book does not list falls back to its W20 row.

refused.bear: Bear has broken with the Garou over the War of Rage and will be no werewolf pack's totem in this age; even Bear's lesser spirits shun them (DA:W p. 193).

rows.name: Falcon
rows.friends: Silver Fangs (who treat the pack as lesser nobility)
rows.ban: Death before dishonour: a packmate who loses permanent Honor must set it right; if that cannot be done, a Rite of Contrition and then a hopeless fight against a mighty servant of the Wyrm.

rows.name: Grandfather Thunder

notes: Many Garou distrust the pack: in this age ambition is met with suspicion

rows.friends: Shadow Lords (who watch the pack closely)
rows.ban: No respect for the weak: when someone the pack thinks lesser reaches an equal or higher station, the pack works to bring them back down.

rows.name: Horse

effects.tick: Dealing with a werewolf who is not a Warder of Men
effects.note: +2 difficulty to Social rolls with werewolves other than Warders (most Garou scorn a domestic beast's children)

rows.friends: Warders of Men (now and then, for Horse's ties to roads and towns)
rows.ban: Harm no domestic animal that can be spared: hunt wild prey, not cattle, unless starving. Meat already butchered may be eaten, with a Prayer for the Prey for the beast (pp. 228-229).

rows.name: Pegasus

notes: Teaches Gifts of travel and the air
At odds with the Church building on pagan holy ground

rows.refuses: a pack with a Get of Fenris in it
rows.ban: Always aid the females of every species, the young above all; a female tainted by the Wyrm is cleansed rather than killed where that can be done.

rows.name: Stag

effects.note: +1 Stamina die for long-distance running only

rows.friends: Fianna, and honoured among the fae
rows.ban: Respect all prey, with a Prayer for the Prey after every successful hunt, and always aid the fae and their kin.

rows.name: Fenris
rows.friends: Get of Fenris (who test the pack with frenzied hunts and hard fights)
rows.ban: Never pass up a chance to fight.

rows.name: Griffin

notes: Speaks with birds of prey without a Gift

rows.refuses: a pack with even one homid in it
rows.ban: Keep no company with humans; any who stray into Griffin's lands are hunted and killed (p. 230).

notes: Rat speaks to the pack through any rodent
Some Garou shun the pack, fearing the plague that follows rats

rows.name: Cockroach

effects.tick: Dealing with craft, trade or human affairs (commerce, alchemy, the Church) or Weaver spirits
effects.note: -2 difficulty with the works and affairs of humans

notes: Message by cockroach (a Pack trait): give a cockroach two or three sentences, a city and the name of another child of Cockroach; a Gaffling passes it on when that Garou next enters the city, a day at the soonest, and forgets it after two weeks (p. 231).

rows.ban: Take pains never to kill a cockroach.

rows.name: Owl

notes: Grows wings in the Umbra and flies as fast as it runs in Hispo
Premonitions of danger and of lost holy places
Many take the pack for a harbinger of death; where plague is rife it may be blamed and driven off

rows.friends: Silent Striders (Ratkin and Rat's children are cool toward them)
rows.ban: Leave bound or helpless rodents in the woods for Owl and its kind.

notes: Raven's children chase every rumour of the prophecies
Resources 1 as a Pack trait: the pack never goes short of bread or coin (p. 231).

rows.name: Unicorn

effects.note: -2 difficulty to healing and empathy (the book makes it a Pack trait; WoDX gives it to each packmate, B7861)

effects.tick: Hurting a Garou who is not of the Wyrm

notes: Moves at twice the usual speed in the Umbra

rows.friends: Children of Gaia (who aid the pack and side with it in disputes)
rows.ban: Aid and protect the weak and the exploited, so long as that does not serve the Wyrm.
